about: THE NAME LIST. Every name a player sees for a car, an engine or a part comes from this file.
Change a "brand" or a "name" here, save, reload the game: the new name is in the menu, garage and HUD.
"real" is only a note for us (which real thing it stands for). Players never see it.
Brands are the made-up ones in reference/speedx/brands/catalog.json.
